title: Astra vs Divi
description: A documentation-led comparison of Astra’s flexible theme ecosystem and Divi’s all-in-one visual-building workflow.
metaDescription: A transparently scoped Astra versus Divi WordPress comparison from KreativWP.
comparisonAreas: Starter templates and preferred editor workflow
How much of the site system lives in the theme versus a visual builder
Pricing, migration, and long-term editor fit
Performance testing still required on the same representative site
takeaway: Choose Astra when you want flexibility across WordPress editing workflows; evaluate Divi when a unified visual builder and its broader ecosystem fit the team. Neither choice should be made without confirming editor ownership and migration expectations.

decisionGuide.chooseLeft: you want to choose your preferred block-editor or page-builder stack independently and value a broad starter-template ecosystem.
decisionGuide.chooseRight: your team wants to standardize on one visual builder for pages and site-wide templates.
decisionGuide.verify: Build one representative page, template, and responsive variation in each workflow. Confirm the migration path and exact plan before committing.

rows.label: Editing approach
rows.left: Use WordPress blocks or your chosen page builder; Astra supplies the theme foundation.
rows.right: Divi supplies its own visual builder and site-wide Theme Builder workflow.

rows.label: Free versus paid
rows.left: A free theme is available. Astra Pro and template/plugin packages add paid capabilities.
rows.right: A paid ecosystem; no free Divi theme edition is listed. Confirm the current license and included products.

rows.label: Templates and dependencies
rows.left: Starter sites are part of a separate template ecosystem; check the editor and plugins required by each import.
rows.right: Layouts and site templates are designed around the Divi builder. Check the specific layout’s requirements.

rows.label: Store workflow
rows.left: WooCommerce integration in the theme; advanced controls depend on edition and configuration.
rows.right: WooCommerce modules and product templates within the visual-building system.

migration: Separate theme settings from builder content. On a staging copy, change the theme and inspect headers, product templates, and one existing page. Moving away from a visual builder may require rebuilding layouts; no migration exercise or speed comparison is claimed here.
